# One Integration & Clearer Setup

Hold & Latch is now a proper integration instead of a helper. All your holds live under one Hold & Latch entry, each with its own device. Setup is clearer too, and the door latch is now an optional add-on.

### Changed
- **One integration, many holds.** Adding Hold & Latch sets up your first hold. Add more with **Add hold** on the integration page, and change one with **Edit hold** in its **⋮** menu. It no longer appears under Helpers.
- **Clearer first screen.** Choose between **One sensor** and **A whole room**, with a short explanation of what a hold does.
- **Door latch is optional.** Tick **Add a door latch** to get the latch screen. Leave it unticked for a plain hold.
- **Filtered pickers.** The sensor picker only lists motion and occupancy sensors. The door picker only lists door, garage door and opening sensors.
- **Latch position instead of sensor polarity.** Choose to latch the room **while the door is closed** (ensuites, toilets, studies) or **while the door is open**. The open option also covers door sensors that report the opposite way round.

### Upgrade notes
- **Existing holds are migrated automatically.** Each becomes a hold under Hold & Latch, keeping its entity IDs, device and saved state. A door set to "Closed (inverted)" becomes "while the door is open", which behaves the same.
- If you set up more than one hold on v0.1.0, each stays as its own Hold & Latch entry after the update. They keep working. To combine them, delete the extras and add them again with **Add hold**.
- Requires Home Assistant 2025.3 or later. Automated tests run on Home Assistant 2026.2.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/Hold-Latch/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
